description: Answer a question about a shop that its menu doesn't: dietary needs and allergies (gluten-free, vegan, nuts), reviews, opening hours, where it is, parking, wait times, prices. Use it whenever the user asks something like that about a shop. Send the question in a few words, without names or other personal details. It answers from what the shop has said, says plainly what the shop hasn't, and tells the shop which topics people ask about (never the question itself).

question.description: The question in a few words, e.g. "gluten-free options?" or "is there parking?"

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: ask_about_shop
title: Ask about a shop
